loading.title: Checking your access…
loading.text: Checking your Discord session and the servers linked to your account.

home.title: Manage Muse.
home.intro: Sign in with Discord to configure the Muse music bots in the servers you administer: language, volume, playlists, auto-disconnect and bot groups.

login.title: Sign in with your Discord account.
login.text: You will only see the servers you can administer and where at least one Muse bot is present.
login.newServerTitle: Muse is not in your server yet?
login.newServerText: For now, Muse bots can only be added to new servers by the project owner.
login.failed: Discord sign-in failed or was cancelled. Please try again.

invite.title: Add the bots to a server.
invite.text: Every bot has its own Discord invite. Add only the ones the server needs.
invite.failed: Could not load the bot list.

servers.title: Choose what to manage
servers.text: Servers where you are the owner, an administrator or have the Manage Server permission.
servers.empty: No manageable servers with Muse found. Check your Discord permissions.

guild.subtitle: Configure one, several or all of the music bots in this server.

overview.title: Music bots in the server
overview.text: Status of every Muse worker in this server.
overview.empty: No Muse bot reachable in this server.

selection.title: Bot selection
selection.text: Settings and groups apply to the selected bots.

settings.title: Settings for the selected bots
settings.text: Turn on only the fields you want to change: every other setting stays as it is.
settings.nothing: Turn on at least one setting to change.
settings.partial: Configuration applied, {count} bots were not updated.

locale.label: Bot language
locale.hint: Language of the bots’ replies and messages · default: English

secondsToWaitAfterQueueEmpties.label: Auto-disconnect
secondsToWaitAfterQueueEmpties.hint: Seconds after the queue empties · 0 = never

leaveIfNoListeners.label: Leave without listeners
leaveIfNoListeners.hint: Leave the voice channel when left alone

queueAddResponseEphemeral.label: Private reply
queueAddResponseEphemeral.hint: Queue confirmation visible only to whoever asked

autoAnnounceNextSong.label: Announce the next track
autoAnnounceNextSong.hint: Automatic message when the next track starts

turnDownVolumeWhenPeopleSpeak.label: Lower while people speak
turnDownVolumeWhenPeopleSpeak.hint: Turns the music down when someone talks

groups.title: Server groups
groups.text: Reusable combinations such as 3+2 or 4+1, overlapping too. They only apply to this server.
groups.empty: No groups created for this server.
groups.newHint: Select the bots above, give the group a name and save.
groups.editHint: The selection above shows the group’s available members.
groups.name: Group name
groups.preserved: {count} unavailable members will be kept in the group.
groups.selectedPartial: Group “{name}” selected: {count} unavailable members were not selected.
groups.nameRequired: Enter a name for the group.
groups.confirmDelete: Delete the group “{name}”? The bots and their settings will not change.

super.title: Global control of Muse.
super.intro: Worker status, linked servers, blacklist and the log of super-admin actions.
super.denied: Access denied. This area is reserved for the configured super admin.
super.botsText: One worker per Discord bot. Invites use each bot’s application ID.
super.guildsText: Every server where at least one Muse bot is present.
super.confirmBlock: Block “{name}” and make every Muse bot leave?
super.blocksText: Blocked users cannot sign in to the dashboard or use the bots; blocked servers are left.
super.invalidId: Enter a valid Discord ID (17–20 digits).
super.reasonTooLong: The reason can be at most 500 characters long.
super.auditText: Latest actions taken from the super console.

errors.forbidden: Action not allowed. Reload the page and try again.
errors.rateLimited: Too many changes in a short time: try again shortly.
errors.unavailable: Service temporarily unavailable. Try again shortly.
